retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century record cover featuring a central circular portrait overlaying a mechanical jukebox background with heavy, blocky sans-serif display type.
triggerTerms: circular inset portrait with mechanical background

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a dark, mechanical jukebox background. A large yellow circular inset contains a close-up portrait of a smiling man. The top of the frame features two tiers of heavy, sans-serif text in yellow and white.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular portrait centered horizontally in the lower two-thirds
Mechanical jukebox structure providing a dark, textured backdrop
Bold, stacked typography aligned to the top left
High-contrast color blocks of yellow against dark shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a head-and-shoulders portrait inside a large circle occupying the center-bottom; the secondary subject is the jukebox filling the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow circle containing the portrait acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold top typography, move down to the bright yellow circle, and then explore the mechanical details of the jukebox background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the jukebox machine and large graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns of the jukebox machine.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow used for the circular background and top-line text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white for the primary artist name text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the vibrant yellow/white elements.

letterConstructionRules: Top line uses an ultra-extended, heavy sans-serif
Bottom line uses a tall, condensed, heavy sans-serif
Uniform stroke weights with no serifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-extended and ultra-condensed widths of the same weight.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, condensed, heavy display text.
Matches the wide, blocky top-line text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a vintage 1950s jukebox in a dark room, with a large yellow circle centered in the lower half containing a portrait of a smiling man.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the top left corner: the top line in a wide yellow sans-serif and the bottom line in a tall white condensed sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait inside a perfect circle?
Are the fonts heavy and sans-serif?
Is the top line yellow and the bottom line white?
Is the background a mechanical jukebox?

mustAchieve: High contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Verify circular mask edges are sharp
Ensure jukebox details are visible but dark
Confirm color palette is limited to yellow, white, and dark tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Square layout + Jukebox background + Circular portrait inset + Stacked wide/narrow bold sans-serif typography.
